--help.stdout:
Usage: thoth [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                                              
                                                                                                                       
 Open the CLI shell when no subcommand is supplied.                                                                    
                                                                                                                       
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --workspace               PATH  [default: contract-workspace]                                                       │
│ --sandbox-profile         TEXT  disabled, docker-poc, gvisor, or managed-e2b [default: disabled]                    │
│ --connector-config        FILE                                                                                      │
│ --help                          Show this message and exit.                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Commands ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ version                   Report build and protocol versions.                                                       │
│ workspace                 Show the selected data root and legacy paths without opening or moving them.              │
│ claude-code-login         Open the official Claude Code sign-in for THOTH's isolated profile.                       │
│ doctor                    Check local runtime capabilities without external calls.                                  │
│ connector-sandbox-doctor  Inspect optional connector SDKs and sandbox runtimes without executing code.              │
│ profile-check             Validate one deployment/model/connector boundary profile without activating it.           │
│ auth-status               Report isolated Codex connectivity without exposing credentials.                          │
│ auth-connect              Keep the official login listener owned until completion or bounded timeout.               │
│ model-probe               Use the normal workspace-bound model-only transport for one synthetic canary.             │
│ source-stage              Copy one user-selected source into the bounded workspace inbox.                           │
│ git-snapshot              Create a read-only Git identity/status manifest in the workspace inbox.                   │
│ run                       Execute one JSON-RPC request and emit one machine-readable JSON result.                   │
│ rpc                       Serve JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout JSONL until EOF.                                         │
│ events                    Read one operation's hash-chained events and latest checkpoint.                           │
│ run-pack                  Run one late-bound ProjectPack through ScriptedModel or Codex OAuth.                      │
│ serve                     Run the local HTTP app server on loopback by default.                                     │
│ hosted-review-serve       Bind the judge-facing review server. Local serve/desktop stay on loopback.                │
│ desktop                   Serve the existing web UI and local backend in one loopback window.                       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Usage: thoth git-snapshot [OPTIONS]

┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐

│    --workspace         PATH       [default: contract-workspace]                                                     │
│    --help                         Show this message and exit.                                                       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
